context: Desktop-style accounting software (Electron based) for Kaccha Arhat/Galla businessmen (Indian Mandi). High data density, fast keyboard entry.
language_strategy: Hinglish UI. All labels and menus must use traditional business terms.

typography.rules: The Anti-Default Rule applied. High legibility for data, authoritative for headings.

data_and_numbers.note: CRITICAL: All amounts, rates, weights, and quantities MUST use this monospace font for tabular alignment.

background.note: Base app uses a muted parchment/bone-white tone to reduce eye strain during long hours. Sidebar is dark charcoal for contrast.

brand.note: Traditional 'Lal Bahi' (Red Ledger) terracotta red. Use sparingly for primary actions (Naya Bill, Save).

spacing_and_layout.strategy: MODE B: The Control Room Grid (For Dashboards/Data). High density, fast scanning.
spacing_and_layout.general: Everything must be accessible on desktop without scrolling where possible. Use full height 'h-screen' layouts.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar ('w-64'), dark theme, clear Hinglish navigation.
spacing_and_layout.cards_and_surfaces: Neumorphism is BANNED. Use flat surfaces with sharp 1px borders ('border-[#D6D1C4]'). Rounded corners must not exceed 'rounded-sm' (2px-4px) to maintain a serious software feel.

components_strategy.tables: MANDATORY. Must be dense ('p-2' or 'p-1.5' padding in cells). Sticky headers. Hover states on rows ('hover:bg-[#F9F8F6]'). Alternating row colors (zebra striping) for readability of long Rokad/Khata lists.
components_strategy.forms: Inputs must have 1px solid borders. Focus states must be highly visible ('focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8B2520]/20 focus:border-[#8B2520]').
components_strategy.buttons: Square or minimal radius ('rounded-sm'). Solid brand color for primary, outline for secondary. Add keyboard shortcut hints (e.g., 'Save (Ctrl+S)') in tooltips or text.
components_strategy.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Solid white background, hard border, subtle ambient shadow. No glassmorphism.
components_strategy.shadcn_overrides: Do not use default rounded-md/lg. Override border radii to 0px or 2px. Remove heavy box-shadows.

motion_and_interactions.rules: Keep it snappy. No long fades. This is a tool for fast typing.

icons_and_media.icon_style: Weight: 'regular' for menus, 'bold' for active states.

login_background.description: Traditional red ledger background for the login screen. Place on the left half of the screen, with a solid white login form on the right half.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure IBM Plex Mono numbers in Jama (Green) and Kharch (Red) meet 4.5:1 against white.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: CRITICAL: All inputs, buttons, and table rows MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="btn-naya-bill"', 'data-testid="input-jama-amount"').
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard: Ensure logical tab index through forms (e.g., Party Name -> Item -> Rate -> Weight -> Add).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: Work Sans, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts.
Set up Tailwind config with the specified 'bone-white/parchment' background and 'terracotta' primary color.
Build a persistent layout with a sidebar containing the Hinglish menu.
For the Rokad Panna (Cashbook), build a two-column or strictly tabular layout showing Jama on one side/column and Kharch on the other.
Ensure all numbers are right-aligned in tables.
Keep the UI dense; do not use excessive padding inside data tables.
Implement the login screen using the provided login_background URL.
Apply 'data-testid' universally across all interactive elements.
